notes.title: Down Fall - Vertical, Knock-out Battle Royale
notes.content: Learn about the new UE5 vertical, knock-out battle royale where only the zone can kill you. Use weapons to damage and knock other players out of the zone. Multiple procedural generated levels give you the opportunity to stay safe at the top or venture down for better items and more risk.

notes.title: Demo Play test tonight 8pm ET / 5pm PDT / 2am CET / 8am CST
notes.content: For anyone interested in trying the game. I will be hosting a game and helping people learn and try out Down Fall
